name: 2-2 Boys
description: 2-2 Boys (also known as the Insane Two Two Boys) is a Chicago-area street gang originating near 22nd Street and California Avenue in the Marshall Square neighborhood on the city's West Side. A Folks Nation-aligned gang, they expanded into Cicero and the western suburbs of Berwyn, Lagrange, and Countryside. They were rivals of the Berwyn Kings and were among the Folks gangs contending with the People Nation-aligned 12th Street Players in the western suburbs during the 1980s.
